reviews.text:
I had a very bad experience with Safe Haven Animal Hospital and was extremely disappointed with the service, communication, and lack of transparency.

One of my biggest concerns was the non-refundable fee related to my pet’s operation. This policy was not clearly explained to me beforehand. When someone is making an important and potentially expensive medical decision for their pet, all fees especially anything that is non-refundable should be communicated clearly before payment is taken.

I felt there was a serious lack of clarity regarding the charges and policies, and I was very disappointed with how the situation was handled.

Based on my personal experience, I would not recommend Safe Haven Animal Hospital. I strongly encourage anyone considering treatment or surgery here to ask for all costs, cancellation policies, and non-refundable fees in writing before making any payment.

Always clean, thorough and kind.  They do an initial exam, prepare an estimate, then present it to you with no pressure, just patience and understanding. Walk-ins must arrive early, but trust the process: it’s worth the wait!

Have been here several times before, and they do take good care of the animals. But the wait time has continued to get worse and worse over the last year. It's irresponsible and inconsiderate to have people and their pets waiting for hours to be seen just to avoid the process of appointments (and presumably, of no shows). I arrived before opening and still wasn't seen for 2.5hr. Went again another time and was told they couldn't even guarantee my pet would be seen before closing time. If you have literally all day to spend at the vet, then this is your place. But if you have a job or any other responsibilities, I would think twice before sinking time into waiting at Safe Haven.
Excelente place to take your pets to see a professional vet and staff
Great clinic for your furry ones! Sunday you have to be in line since 7am because it's first come first serve. They open at 10am.  You can check their hours of operation on their website.

It has been a couple years since I've been here (Thankfully) I came last weekend for another member of the family and they proved they're still just as amazing if not more ! They took in my Stella, Listened to her symptoms asked my budget and informed me that by what it sounds like it may go over my budget and directed me to a resource.  They examined her, contacted me while she was atill being examed and provided information on the vets next steps and provided current estimate. After a while amd getting the results they gave me detailed information on their findings and what it was going to take to make her better , they worked so well woth her, gave her fluids and medications and provided me with instructions to care for her at home during recovery. She instantly improved when we got home, she hadn't had anything to eat or drink from days and the first thing she did was take a couple laps of water and about 30 minutes later got her appetite.  Not long later she was back to her clingy loving self and I could breathe again ♥️💓😻🩺👩‍⚕️🏥
Staff is just so very amazing and kind . This couldnt be any better of a beautiful organization ❤️
THANK YOU SO MUCH!

First 3 pictures of her before, she wanted to eat so bad she'd got to the water/food and just stare at it :( next pictures immediately following visit in order. Much improvement 💕

The wait time is crazyyyyy, but it's all worth it for our furry ones. Arrive early, around 9am and take the day off, you'll spend most of it here!
I arrived around 11ish and left around 4ish...
The visit is a bit different than other places but they are all very nice and informative, not to mention is very pocket friendly $ and they give you the medicine right there and you can order some online!
It's worth everything when your pets are the priority. Thank you for the hard work!!
Friendly staff and fair pricing on services.

This place is amazing they are kind and compassionate to our Fur babies, they do surgeries and everything. My cat got his arm ripped off and they fixed him
My dog has heart worms they fix him. They always are the best. Show up early though or you will wait all day. They will not let you use the rr either, so make sure you are good before you leave the house

My dog had a very affordable dental cleaning with some extractions, and let me tell you... You can tell he had some immediate relief. I've never seen him so happy. I myself am so happy that the vet staff was very informative, warm, and attentive. You can tell they care. Amazing service and I will be coming back for regular checkups. Thank you so much!

You know how you feel when people are genuinely interested in caring for your fur child? That's unfortunately not what transpired when I took my Service Dog to Safe Haven Animal Hospital. The veterinarian was a wonderfully kind man. The staff? Not so much.

Safe Haven Animal Hospital staffers have beyond awful "bedside manners". Because here's the thing: If you don't want to be on video camera when you walk in to inquire about services or you're there after a surgical procedure, and not a video camera placed somewhere in a business in a normal way that most businesses place them - but instead, there is a video camera placed directly on YOU, because apparently they think that you're going to act so dispicably ugly. Because they must have people trying to go over the counter to attack them - which is unfortunate, but certainly wouldn't surprise me. So, this is probably not the place you want to go for veterinary hospital services. And sadly, because they appear to have a chip on their shoulders and as a result they will likely treat you in a condescending and unpleasant way - I guess that's why they feel the need to put EVERYONE who goes there ON CAMERA - in the manner in which they have placed a video camera on their countertop. I was SHOCKED to say the least, until I was talked rudely to. You know what I mean; the kind of people who have a bad attitude and act like you didn't hear what they said the first time and feel the need to repeat themselves over and over again, as if you're stupid. All I can think is, apparently, because they're rude with absolutely no regard to how they *should* deal with people, first by actually coming from the position of respecting their customers - people must have gotten so angry with them that they've lunged over the counter at them. So please be advised that you're likely to become their verbal abuse "victim" instead of being treated like a respected customer. It's pretty sad on their part. Because if you think about it, when you operate your business with an "us first, you second" approach, people aren't going want to be willing to pay balances owed and ever return again. In essence, this place is not a good fit for you if think that you're actually receiving financial "help" via Houston PetSet for example (which is a WONDERFUL organization that partners with Safe Haven - which is an oxymoron, because going there felt safe in name only, because being made to be placed on camera didn't "feel" very safe when you're being treated like your behavior is going to be criminal); it actually really winds up costing you twice. First, it costs you when you're concerned and worried about trusting Safe Haven staff-strangers that you're dropping your loved friend(s)/animal(s) off with, hoping that you've making the right decision. Second, it costs you on the back end - if you're struggling financially and don't have a bunch of alternative choices about where to go, and you're stuck being subjugated to their blatantly nasty attitudes, on top of being recorded on their camera that is actually turned in the WRONG direction. They should be ashamed about how they're mistreating people, people who are already freaked out and possibly embarrassed, who aren't accustomed to having to result to using "poor people" services. Because during this era of "Trump pro-rich people first and everyone else second", for those who aren't truly ultra-high-net-worth individuals, that's troubling enough to have to deal with WITHOUT needing help from places like Safe Haven Animal Hospital that aren't concerned about their customers first, and treat everyone who goes there as if YOU'RE going to mistreat THEM. My advice: If you have to go there once, don't go back again. Don't go back to a place that automatically treats you like you're "going to be a problem", displayed by how they've decided to position their camera on YOU. Especially, when the truth is, the way that you just might be treated (again by with the placement of their camera being proof of this fact) is the REAL problem. I do not recommend this place.
The team at Safe Haven was very professional and knowledgeable! They took time to answer our questions.  Very appreciative of their service!
Exceptional service for my fur baby
Everybody that works there are angels. I love that place and I love those people and they are amazing.
I was short on cash. SHAH helped me. My pet needed a $600 surgery.  And I was approved their Cherry program with no credit hit.She is home and in recovery.
Associate very caring,very clean areas and prompt

Pet Parents Beware!!!
My beloved pet had a horrific dental experience here! I took my Yorkie in for multiple extractions. I dropped off at 8:15 am as instructed and told to pick up No later than 5pm. By 4:00 pm I had heard nothing and headed over because of the distance I live plus traffic. I arrived at 4:35pm and was told he had just been taken into his procedure….. What!!! My little dog was sitting in a cage all day with No food or water! He is going to be dehydrated and maybe hypoglycemic by then. Absolutely No communication whatsoever!!! The complete lack of mutual respect is unacceptable! At 6:00pm the procedure was completed and personnel handed him to me wet, bleeding from his mouth because of the multiple extractions and he could not even stand, walk, or sit up because he had just come out of anesthesia. He was in extreme pain all night, unstable, and bleeding from his mouth. I have Never had such a horrific experience! Not to mentioned the attitude the staff has….. the sour look on everyone’s face and the inability to utter any pleasantries or polite greeting. They act like they are doing you a favor. Well it is a hard NO! I will speak my truth and let everyone know to Beware!!! There are too many other pet clinics that will gladly be polite and it is pathetic I even have to mention this…. It should be automatic to be cordial but here it is Not.
**** This was Not Agatha Rose’s experience it was Teddy Boo!!! He now has Bilateral maxillary fistulas caused by the extractions. Also, prior to this he had No coughing and had Not been diagnosed with a collapsed trachea. Pet Parents BEWARE!!! Do Not fall for excuses and deflection followed by a dash of gaslighting!
Beware! Four words….. just don’t do it!!!
⚠️⚠️⚠️Update⚠️⚠️⚠️My beloved Teddy Boo passed away June 6 due to complications. He fought so hard! We miss you Teddy Boo!!!!!😭
